buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address A & N Bhawan, 12- Chanakyapuri, Bir Tikender jit marg New Delhi PIn-110021 . 3. Generic

Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 9. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 10. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Vehicle: The Bidder should quote the rates of TATA NEXON.ev Creative45". Minimum Electric Motor Power (KW)-110. 2. Charging System: The vehicle shall be supplied with the compatible OEM-supplied AC charging equipme nt/cable and all standard charging accessorie 3. Safety Features: The vehicle shall have all mandatory statutory safety features applicable to the offered variant, including airbags, ABS/EBD, seat belts, parking sensors/camera and other standard safety equipm ent. 4. Registration: The supplier shall provide all documents necessary for registration of the vehicle with the c oncerned RTO/Transport Department, including applicable statutory documents and manufacturer's certific ates. 5. Warranty: The vehicle shall carry the OEM's comprehensive vehicle warranty, and the battery/motor wa rranty shall be as specified by the OEM for the offered variant. The warranty shall be clearly mentioned in the bid. 6. Battery Warranty: The supplier shall clearly specify the warranty period/coverage applicable to the high-

voltage battery, including any applicable kilo metre limitation and battery-performance conditions. 7. Spare Parts: Genuine spare parts and consumables required for maintenan ce shall be made available t hrough authorised service centres. 8. Inspection & Acceptance: The vehicle shall be subject to inspection by the consignee/authorised officer. Payment shall be released only after satisfactory delivery, inspection and acceptance. 9. Documents: The supplier shall provide: a. Tax invoice b. Registration-related documents c. Insurance policy d. Warranty documents e. Owner's manual f. Service/maintenance schedule g. Charging equipment manual h. PDI report i. Any other documents required under the GeM contract/RTO requirements. 10. Standard Accessories: All standard accessories, tools, jack, first-aid kit, warning triangle and other equi pment normally supplied with the vehicle shall be included. 11. Delivery: The vehicle shall be delivered at the location specified in the GeM Contract/Purchase Order, p referably Office of the Resident Commissioner, Andaman & Nicobar Administration, A&N Bhawan, Chanaky apuri, New Delhi if that is your consignee location. 12. Payment: Payment shall be released after successful delivery, inspection and acceptance of the vehicl e and submission of all requisite documents. .
